messages:
Maria Gomez: Heads up — canary is showing a p99 tail spike after merging PR 6321 (allocator autoscale tweak). Can someone take a quick look? perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood.ai/plots/1856/6321
perf-bot: Automated perf run finished: baseline vs PR-6321 -> p50 +2ms, p95 +9ms, p99 +320ms. Full results: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/6321/perf.log
Ajay Patel: On it. Do we have the flamegraphs or heap profiles from the canary run?
Cheng Li: I grabbed the canary artifact and ran a few local microbenchmarks. GC frequency jumped and tail latency climbed. Quick snippet of what I ran:
```bash
# reproduce locally (microbench)
./scripts/run_microbench --seq 1024 --alloc-window 10 --load 200
# results (summary)
p50: 23ms
p95: 118ms
p99: 435ms
```
Sarah O'Neal: Is the regression correlated with the new aggressive scale-down delta? PR diff mentioned reducing scale_down_delay from 30s to 10s. That could cause more frequent warmups.
Maria Gomez: Here's the exact diff from the PR config block:
```diff
- allocator:
-   scale_down_delay: 30
+ allocator:
+   scale_down_delay: 10
+   allow_quick_deschedule: true
```
Ajay Patel: If that's the culprit, we should revert the config tweak and run a canary rollback. Anyone object to a quick revert + canary? :thumbsup:
Cheng Li: Recommend rolling back the config in canary first, then run the full perf-suite. If revert fixes tail, we can open a smaller follow-up to tune heuristics + add a regression test for p99 under long-seq workloads.
ci-bot: Canary rollback initiated: image inference-runtime:v1.18.3 -> v1.18.2. Job: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/rollback-1856-6321 (started)
Maria Gomez: Thanks — canary rollback running. I re-ran the microbench against the rolled-back canary and p99 is back around 112ms. I'll open a hotfix PR to adjust the autoscale heuristics and include a stress test that covers long sequences. @Ajay Patel can you review the hotfix? cc @Cheng Li for perf validation.
Ajay Patel: Acknowledged, I'll take the review in the next hour. If all green, we can cherry-pick the hotfix to the release branch.
Cheng Li: I'll add the perf-suite job to gate future autoscale config changes so we catch this earlier.
Maria Gomez: Cool — thanks everyone. Follow-ups: 1) hotfix PR from me, 2) Cheng adds test, 3) Ajay reviews. I'll post results once the canary completes. :white_check_mark:
